NCP Merger Speculation Denied Amidst Political Maneuvering

Speculation regarding a potential merger within the Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) has been denied by Rohit Pawar, who stated that such rumors are intended to shape the political narrative. This comes amid reports that a proposal for an NCP merger, excluding Sunetra and Parth Pawar, had reached Amit Shah. Devendra Fadnavis confirmed that no formal merger proposal had been received from either Sharad Pawar or Sunetra Pawar. The developments occurred a day after the NCP faction led by Sharad Pawar joined a protest by the INDIA bloc in the national capital.
